otraMarca: It may belong to another brand: check which one you have selected.
programado: Scheduled: goes out {cuando}. You'll see it in the Calendar.
portadaSinVideo: You can pick the cover once the video is ready. If you don't, each network picks its own.
yaPasoLargo: That time has already passed: pick one from now on.
marcaUnaRed: Select at least one network under Where.
sinRedes: This brand has no connected networks. Connect them in <link>Connected networks</link>.

motivos.reconectar: Needs to be reconnected in Connected networks

faltaInstagram: Missing Instagram? It has to be a professional account linked to the Facebook page, and you need to reconnect Facebook accepting the Instagram permissions.
faltaRed: Missing {red}? Connect it on the web, under <link>Connected networks</link>.
soloMira: Your role in this brand is view-only: an editor or the owner does the scheduling.
confirmarCancelar: Cancel the {red} one? It won't go out.
hashtags: Hashtags (the brand's; remove the ones that don't fit this clip)
hashtagsAlFinal: They go at the end of the description, on every network. Ones you already typed in the text aren't repeated.
hashtagsVacio: No hashtags. The brand's usual ones are set in Connected networks.
descripcionLarga: The description with hashtags is over {max} characters: shorten it or remove some.
tituloYoutubeAyuda: YouTube uses this title separately; the description and hashtags go below the video.
comoSale: How it looks on each network

portada.facebook: On Facebook it's applied a few minutes after publishing, if the page is also connected through Facebook (Connected networks → bottom).
portada.youtube: YouTube only applies it on verified channels.

editar.tituloHoras: Already scheduled on {redes}, at different times
editar.ayuda: Change anything and tap "Save changes": the scheduled posts are updated. Unchecking a network cancels it there.
editar.horasAyuda: If you change the date, all of them move to it.
editar.horasPorRed: Each network goes out at its own time
editar.guardado: Done: the scheduled posts were updated.
editar.confirmarCancelar: The scheduled post on {redes} will be canceled. Continue?
editar.confirmarCancelarTodo: Cancel the post on {redes}? It won't go out. The clip stays and you can schedule it again.
editar.canceladoTodo: Post canceled: it won't go out.

reintentar.ayuda: Fix what you need (tags, text, time) and tap "Retry": this same post is sent again, without scheduling another one.
reintentar.listo: Done: {red} is trying again. You can see it below, in Posts.
reintentar.quizas: It may have gone out anyway on {red}: check the account before retrying, so it isn't posted twice.
reintentar.confirmarForzar: If it already went out on {red}, it will be there twice. Retry anyway?

etiquetas.titulo: It failed because of the tags
etiquetas.ayuda: Instagram rejected one of these accounts: it may be private, not exist or not accept collaboration invites. Safest: keep them as tags, not as collaborators.

reintentar.saleYa: Goes out as soon as you tap Retry

duplicado.chipAyuda: Already published on this account on {cuando}
duplicado.pregunta: {n, plural, one {Publish it there again?} other {Publish it again on those accounts?}}

reemplazada.texto: This attempt failed, but it was published on {red} afterwards: nothing to retry.

errorEtiquetas: {red} rejected one of the tagged or collaborator accounts (private, missing, not visible or not accepting collaborations).

video.ayuda: You can schedule once it's ready (usually a couple of minutes). Meanwhile, fill in the rest: it's kept even if you reload.
video.ayudaSoloMira: It's exporting with the latest edit.
video.botonAyuda: Enabled once the video is ready.
video.falloAyuda: Try again; if it fails again, check the clip in the editor.

borrador.recuperado: We restored what you'd left unscheduled.

menu.cancelarDetalle: It won't go out. The clip stays and you can schedule it again.
menu.eliminarDetalle: This clip's scheduled, failed or cancelled posts are deleted from Clipfine, and it can't be undone. What already went out on the networks isn't touched.
